bio.text: Jordan Herrera is the Democratic nominee for Missouri's 4th Congressional District, having won a seven-person primary with 30% of the vote.
He is a U.S. Air Force veteran and has served as an assistant attorney general for Missouri; he has not held public office.
According to his campaign website, he served more than 16 years in the Air Force and earned a J.D. in two years after leaving military service.
